title: G.I. Joe Classified Series #219, M.A.R.S. (Military Armaments Research Syndicate) S.N.A.K.E. (System Neutralizer-Armed Kloaking Equipement) Battle Suit (Amazon Exclusive)
features: YO JOE! G.I. JOE EXPLODES INTO A LARGER-THAN-LIFE ERA WITH 6 INCH ACTION FIGURES: The G.I. Joe Classified Series evolves the retro toy soldier figures fans know and love into a highly articulated 6-inch (15 cm) scale with premium deco and detailing
CLASSIC BATTLE SUIT-INSPIRED DESIGN: Features a classic design updated to bring the Destro-designed battle armor into the modern era and 15 accessory pieces inspired by the battle suit's rich history

FITS MOST 6 INCH ACTION FIGURES: Suit up! Put your Cobra and G.I. Joe Classified Series figures (each sold separately) at the articulated controls and have them tower over the battlefield inside the 11.9" (304mm) mechanized battle suit

HIGHLY POSEABLE WITH PREMIUM DETAILING: G.I. Joe Classified Series M.A.R.S. (Military Armaments Research Syndicate) S.N.A.K.E. (System Neutralizer-Armed Kloaking Equipement) Battle Suit action figure set features exceptional detailing and articulation for cool poseability to create dazzling dioramas (some poses may require additional support)
DETAILED COCKPIT INTERIORS: The battle suit cockpit features articulated control sticks, and targeting, sensors, and heads-up display details that put its enemies in its deadly sights

COLLECTIBLE PACKAGING: #219 in the Classified Series sequence. The closed-box display showcases accessory loadout, figure-specific File Card Icons, gorgeous original character artwork, and dynamic digital renders
KNOWING IS HALF THE BATTLE: Look for other G.I. Joe toy figures, playsets, and vehicles to build your roster of heroes and Cobra villains (Each sold separately. Subject to availability.)
